findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
The facility could not locate any test strips (quat). Ensure that test strips are available to accurately measure sanitizer concentrations properly. Will follow up 5/31/2024. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sink to not have an adequate flow of hot water. Ensure that the handwashing sink has an adequate flow of running hot water to wash hands properly. Will follow up 5/31/2024. 

5-103.12: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, EQUIPMENT, and nonFOOD EQUIPMENT that are required to use water except that water (A) and (B) to a TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT or in response to a temporary interruption of a water supply need not be under pressure.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Observed the bar hand sink to not have hand soap at the start of the inspection. Ensure hand sinks are supplied with soap. Soap was put at the hand sink during the inspection. 
Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed black slime mold on the baffle of the ice machine.  Clean ice machine baffle

750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer was visible in the reach in cooler at the bar that is holding juices. Provide a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to +/- 3 degrees F.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed salt being stored in medicine bottles from the pharmacy as bartender states that the glass salt shakers get stolen. Do not store salt in containers that once contained medications. Properly protect food.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the wood surfaces behind the bar to be unsealed plywood. Paint or seal wood. Paint or seal plywood so that it is smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the upright freezer holding glasses to have significant ice accumulation as the corner of this freezer is crushed and it does not close entirely. Defrost freezer and make sure it seals completely to avoid re-accumulation.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice deflector flap in the ice machine to be soiled with friable black mold. Wash, rinse and sanitize the ice machine.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the drain cup at the soda gun to be soiled.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the counter at the bar where the hand sink is to not be sealed to the wall. 2) Observed both the men's and women's restroom sinks to be separating from the wall. Caulk counter and sinks to the wall. 3) Observed the walls and ceilings in the walk in cooler to be unsealed plywood. Paint or seal plywood so that it is smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed two light bulbs in the walk in cooler to not be shielded. Shield lights in the walk in cooler.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
Observed that the inside of the pizza warming oven had some accumulation of soil from pizza preparation.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors
Observed the floors under the coolers and cabinets behind the bar to be soiled.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of mildew inside the drink dispenser and holder.  Observed some baked on pizza on the pizza tray.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
Clean and sanitize the drink dispenser and pizza tray.  Corrected.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The ceilings in the restrooms are not smooth.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  
At the next remodel:  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed roasting pans and other cooking equipment in the walk in cooler.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
Remove these from the facility.
